sourceWork.fullMacroScope: Separated builtins and current namespace, explicit MacroState persistence, global_group, cleanup/currentcolor/tag, local/global def/gdef/edef/xdef/let/futurelet/globalfuture, hash-before-brace parameter text and exact delimited argument matching.
sourceWork.all20ContextMacros: All source context names now have native implementations including bra@ket/bra@set temporary active bars, tag@literal, newcommand context execution during expansion, noexpand and expandOnce return semantics.
sourceWork.userMacroAPI: String, native Macro, source reversed-token expansion dictionary, pure Python callback with documented MacroContext methods and validated/budgeted results. Native Macro.tokens/numArgs/get expose source expansion conventions.
sourceWork.sourceArguments: Ordinary raw token argument isolation versus primitive/group/script parsing; unexpanded optional lookahead; complete mode flags and allowedInArgument data; source color and unanchored measurement regex; cfrac has no optional alignment per fixedsource.
sourceWork.environmentBranches: All33 fixed environments. Per-cell namespaces, ams display context, row tag flags/manual tags/nonumber, cell styles, source col gaps, alignat counts, subarray restrictions, hlines, optional rowgap whitespace, trailing empty rows and CD implicit cell/arrows.
sourceWork.staticHTMLAndImages: All htmlClass/htmlId/htmlStyle/htmlData and includegraphics source arguments/trust contexts become pure AST. URL category handling preserves percent/tilde and source trust-protocol validation; rejection is visible unsupported node, not silent content loss. Native provider owned by C.
sourceWork.settings: Display/tag restriction, strict warn/error/ignore/Python callbacks, source report=False behavior, colorIsTextColor, fractional/infinite/clamped expansion budgets, noThrow unknown continuation, codepoint plus UTF16 error provenance including lexer construction.
sourceWork.unicode: 344 source-generated precomposed mappings,12 combining accent commands,dotless i/j,10supported script ranges,102Unicode superscript/subscript mappings,wide-alphabet original identity and text ligatures.

staticSourceAnomaliesPreserved.source: functions/genfrac.ts lacks numOptionalArgs; [l]/[r] are normal source tokens, not native optional syntax.
environments/cd.ts appends an empty row after each parsed row; final empty row retained and cols length follows first row.
Parser.parseSizeGroup finds the first measurement substring; native does not invent anchored rejection for source-accepted trailing text.
Unicode script assignment overwrites a prior matching explicit script; explicit duplicate ^/_ still errors.

limitations: No new P1 parser/layout/render behavior tests or image/oracle probes executed. Existing alpha success is not evidence for this full candidate.

Native AST projection does not recreate HTML/MathML hosts, JS object identity/prototypes, navigation handlers or external script execution. Static style/image layout/paint verification is owned by B/C and remains unverified.

Documented native MacroContext aliases preserve source token conventions; namespace.current is an inspection snapshot, mutations use set or explicit MacroState. Python callables replace explicitly supplied source macro/trust/strict callbacks; no source JS strings are executed.

Node/depth/token bounds and finite-geometry checks remain native safety constraints independent of maxExpandInfinity. They can explicitly reject pathological source inputs instead of attempting invalid infinite geometry.

All345 registered source names and339macros having dispatch is a source completeness statement, not measured branch coverage or full compatibility proof. Exhaustive source/spec behavior and errors remain P2/P3 responsibilities.
Installation validation and publishing/commit/push remain deferred.

repairs.change: Import existing pure lexer for current-color and colorIsTextColor definitions; remove NameError.
Apostrophe is a text nucleus outside math; bm normalizes boldsymbol; emph retains dynamic text-shape identity; implicit Unicode accents retain source mode.
Absent root index selects primitive parsing after expansion, consuming one group; Unicode mapped scripts use subparse so macros and expansion budgets apply.
Register all dynamic macros as callable builtin definitions, exposing lookup/let/macros.get; callback evaluated before expansion-count check.

Normalize one braced sized delimiter; retain regex size lookahead at next raw argument; reject missing nonbraced size and empty explicit matrix alignment; expand global prefix alias; do not scan newline optional gap across space.
Parse nonvisual htmlmathml alternative; unknown control length uses token size; source mathVsSout strict report preserved.

finalPrimitiveArgumentRepair.change: Reject ^/_ tokens when a primitive root argument has no nucleus; retain error at codepoint/UTF16 position5. Top-level/script empty bases keep their existing source semantics.
